channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Corey Brewer | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Corey Brewer from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: James Harden on Corey Brewer
item.description:
Michael Lee:James Harden on Corey Brewer:

“He's annoying man. He's on a 10-day, so he's fighting for his career. He did an unbelievable job of being active & bringing the extras to the game.”

James Harden on Corey Brewer, Jan 22, 2019. Source: Twitter @MrMichaelLee.

item.title: Mike D'Antoni on Corey Brewer
item.description:
Rockets coachMike D’Antoni on new Thunder addition Corey Brewer:

“That’s one of my favorite players. One of the funniest guys of all time.”

Mike D'Antoni on Corey Brewer, Mar 6, 2018. Source: Twitter @BDawsonWrites.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Corey Brewer
item.description:
Fred Katz:Donovan on Corey Brewer:

“He’s obviously a guy that I love to death and shared a lot of incredible experiences together. I love his family. For me, to be able to be reunited at the NBA level with a player you coached in college is always great.”

Billy Donovan on Corey Brewer, Mar 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Billy Donovan on Corey Brewer
item.description:
Fred Katz:Donovan on getting Corey Brewer minutes with the starters:

“The goal would be to get Corey more than 12 minutes a game. Now whether that means starting him or him coming off the bench, I’m not quite sure”

Billy Donovan on Corey Brewer, Mar 5, 2018. Source: Twitter @FredKatz.

item.title: Rob Pelinka on Corey Brewer
item.description:
Ryan Ward:Rob Pelinka on Corey Brewer:

“It was a pleasure to have Corey on our team. Corey’s professionalism & competitive mindset will leave a positive mark on the #Lakers for a long time. We appreciate his time w the team & wish him the best of luck for the remainder of his career.”

Rob Pelinka on Corey Brewer, Feb 28, 2018. Source: Twitter @RyanWardLA.

item.title: Luke Walton on Corey Brewer, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope
item.description:
Luke Walton:

“A lot of it is what they’ve [Kentavious Caldwell-Pope and Corey Brewer] brought to the table those two. Being a hard-nose, being able to make the right read and switch and get after people, be the aggressors on that end of it, and they play like that in practice all the time too. I thought our young guys see what that looks like and they get a feel of what that’s like playing against each day in practice. Obviously there’s a lot of other reasons too, but that’s a big part of what’s helped change the way that we’re playing defense.”

Luke Walton on Corey Brewer, Kentavious Caldwell-Pope, Nov 21, 2017. Source: Lakers Nation.

item.title: Dave Joerger on Corey Brewer, Alexey Shved
item.description:
“One of the underrated pickups of the year I think will end up being their deal where they brought in Corey Brewer and Alexey Shved,”

Dave Joerger on Corey Brewer, Alexey Shved, Dec 27, 2014. Source: Houston Chronicle.

item.title: Flip Saunders on Corey Brewer
item.description:
Andy Greder:#Twolves president Flip Saunders on Corey Brewer trade report:

“We are not going to make a snap decision to help us win four more games.”

Flip Saunders on Corey Brewer, Nov 17, 2014. Source: Twitter @twolvesnow.

item.title: Ricky Rubio on George Karl, Corey Brewer
item.description:
Ricky Rubio:

“Corey Brewer has talked a lot about George Karl all season. He loves him. We enjoyed seeing him two seasons ago with Denver.”

Ricky Rubio on George Karl, Corey Brewer, May 19, 2014. Source: Canal Plus.
